seo_title: California High School Scholarships with Varying Awards
seo_description: Explore 17 California high school scholarships with varying award amounts. Check individual listings for deadlines and requirements.
intro: Finding scholarships can significantly ease the financial burden of high school education in California. This collection features 17 scholarships with varying award sizes, from approximately $400 to $15,000. While many listings do not require essays, it's important to note that deadlines and specific eligibility criteria differ across each opportunity. Be sure to check the details closely to identify options that align with your needs and timelines.
